stages.description: 追蹤 group-by 前後的 partition 分配，找出單一 hot key 限制平行度。 1000000筆，hot key占400000，其餘平均分到7個partition；總共8個partition。 將鍵、型別、時間或版本欄分列，指出每筆資料的唯一身份；對NULL、重複或無限邊界做明確約定。
stages.descriptionEn: Trace partition assignment around grouping and identify a hot key limiting parallelism. One million rows include a 400000-row hot key; remaining rows spread over seven other partitions; eight total. Tabulate keys,types,time/version fields and stable identities; explicitly handle NULLs,duplicates and unbounded endpoints.
